items.item_text: Minimum of 3-5 years combined experience in healthcare industry
1-2 years of experience with a minimum of1 year in area of related field. Experiencein placing and reading PPDs,administering flu shots and fit testing and other health care surveillance.
Demonstrates setting priorities, problem solving and critical thinking and follows-through with clinical assigned job functions.
Demonstrates organizational skills in office management such as filing, trending and tracking data in a timely manner. Designs checklists, spreadsheets and forms as needed for department.
Maintains confidential employee files in a database and physical file with required elements present. Maintains PPD files for volunteers/contract staff.
Coordinates annual health exams/screens following protocols, with appropriate follow up on screening/test results as indicated.
Administers immunizations/vaccines for employees, volunteers and physicians. Tuberculosis skin tests, annually, and post exposure. Hepatitis B vaccine series. Flu vaccine.

Works in conjunction with the Infection Control Practitioner to ensure that employee exposures receive appropriate medical treatment and counseling, are documented and reported as required by OSHA mandates and policy.
Graduate of a Registered Nurse Program.
